topics.topic: Error/precheck precedence in runs.continue_after_approval and runs.continue_after_resolution (run-ended check vs unknown approval/attempt)
questions: If the approval id is unknown, what is checked first in practice, and which refusal is returned before any run-ended check can be applied?
If the attempt id is unknown, is unknown_reference returned immediately, or is there a defined way to prioritize ended-run refusal first?
How does `runs` perform the mandated 'run-not-ended first' check when it receives only approval/attempt identity and `effects` owns those records?

topics.topic: Identity/selector for reading one SpooledFile when a single producer key can map to multiple files on a many port
questions: How is one specific file selected when a single (`run_id`,`producer_node_id`,`map_index`,`attempt_number`,`producer_port`) can correspond to multiple files from a `many` file port?
How is one file selected when one attempt produces multiple files on the same `producer_port` (for a `many` file port), including repeated files?

topics.topic: Required behavior when an unpaged read response is very large (full return vs refusal vs paging/streaming)
questions: What must happen if a slot history is very large (response size/serialization/memory pressure): always return full history, or refuse/page?
If an unpaged response becomes very large, what is the required behavior (return fully, refuse with a specific code, or paginate/stream despite being defined unpaged)?

topics.topic: Canonical fields included in every "run's answer" response across run lifecycle operations
questions: What exact fields make up a "run's answer" (for start_run, read_run, resume_run, continue_after_approval, continue_after_resolution, cancel_run, release_run): does it always include run_id and pinned version metadata, or only status/outputs/waiting?

topics.topic: Error class for grant_standing_approval when node id is absent from the active flow version
questions: When the flow exists and is active, but the requested node id is not in that active version (for example it existed only in an older version), must the operation return `refused` or `unknown_reference`?

topics.topic: Version scope of trial evidence shown in get_repair_view (all contract versions vs current only)
questions: Does repair view include trial cases/executions for all contract versions of the slot, or only current contract/current implementation?

topics.topic: What payload recovery APIs must return (details vs identifiers vs count vs none)
questions: What is the concrete output form of recover_in_flight_attempts (list of records, count, or just done)?
What exact data must recover_running_runs return to its caller: detailed run states, identifiers only, count, or none?

topics.topic: Whether agents may read arbitrary implementation bodies or only current implementation in repair context
questions: May any agent read arbitrary implementation code, or only the current implementation in repair context?

topics.topic: Who supplies the Actor identity for store.record_change during startup recovery
questions: When startup recovery writes records, who provides the Actor to store.record_change: must callers pass kernel explicitly, or does store inject it?

topics.topic: get_repair_view pagination contract (page sizes and continuation-token behavior for its lists)
questions: What exact page size is used for each of the three lists in get_repair_view, and does get_repair_view return continuation tokens for those lists or always only a single fixed first page?
